legend: The lesion contains numerous small to medium-sized thin-walled vessels. Bland epithelioid to spindled cells show a predominantly perivascular distribution within an oedematous to myxoid stroma.

Tumour shows well-circumscribed margins and is composed of round to epithelioid cells arranged predominantly in cord-like structures and set in a fibrous stroma; perivascular arrangement of neoplastic cells is seen.

Pedunculated lesion containing numerous small- to medium-sized thin-walled vessels. Bland epithelioid cells show a predominantly perivascular distribution within an oedematous to myxoid stroma. Adipose tissue is also present within the lesion.
